name: Casa Jade Spa
description: A small day spa (fictional example business) offering massages and facials. Payment in cash or card at the spa.
locations: Zona 10, Guatemala City. Parking available in front of the building.

faq.question: Do you sell gift cards?
faq.answer: Yes, for any service. They are paid at the spa and valid for 6 months.

faq.question: Can couples book together?
faq.answer: Yes, we have one couples room; book two services at the same time.

policies: Cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice are charged 50%.
handoffWhen: the customer asks about a medical condition, pregnancy or an allergy
the customer wants a group or corporate booking
the customer asks for a refund or complains about a past visit
